## Description

State the user/stakeholder outcome and enough detail to understand the work. For a bug, include reproduction steps, actual behaviour and expected behaviour. For an epic, link child issues.

## Scope

Record the intended boundary, relevant sources, dependencies and unresolved questions. Mark assumptions explicitly.

## Dependencies

List direct prerequisite issues and the output needed from each, matching `depends_on` and the backlog, or state None. List non-blocking coordination separately; do not treat related links as prerequisites.
